From personal experience, the first 30mins of your characters life is make or break. Chances are, you'll spawn right on the coast, so consume what you have, and immediately search the boats along the coast, before moving onto trees for apples and pears, then houses. Don't be put off by a location having already been looted, as there's a good chance that you'll manage to find something that spawned in after looters ransacked the place. Avoid multiple zombies, and other players at first, and trust no-one. If you do have interactions with another player, always keep your guard up, and if they don't talk within 10secs of you meeting, assume they're in party chat, and plotting with their squad. Don't get me wrong, I've met people in-game, and have become online friends, still playing together months later, but its better to be safe than sorry, especially at first, as bad interactions can put some off of the game, and that's a shame.

items.title: Humming Zombies?
items.text:
Humming Zombies?
Has anyone else encountered humming zombies? I was playing last night, and was almost certain that there were several players in proximity chat, all humming along to what seemed like a random song they had just made up, but upon further investigation, I discovered that it was in fact several zombies, all making a low humming sound at the same time, and it sounded like nothing I had ever heard before in-game. It's like a low humming/growling, but when several do it at once, it sounds rather surreal.

It's more so when there's several of them together, as when alone, it sounds like a low/bassy growl. Soon as I realised it wasn't players I laughed, although it would've been just as funny if it were players. I think it was dark, and I was like wtf.

The audio for them has definitely changed, and not only that, but sometimes they make no sound at all. A few nights back, I was with a friend, taking shelter inside a cabin in one of the summer camps, when we both heard footsteps. There was no other sound except for ambient sounds, and we were sure it was a player, circling the outside of our cabin. After about 5mins, a face appeared at the window, and so I aimed my gun in an attempt to scare them off. I was just about to go into game chat, and try to open up comms with the night creeper, as my raising the gun didn't seem to faze them, when it became slightly lighter outside, and I saw that it was just a zombie.
